decisions.headline: 《Sea of Thieves》第21赛季公布新奖励与跨地区抽奖活动
decisions.reason: 符合固定窗口及来源规则，按已打开证据的事实边界收录。

decisions.headline: 《寂静岭：Townfall》定于9月24日发售，并详解 PS5 沉浸功能

decisions.verification: PlayStation Blog 已打开；标题与正文明确支持日期、平台和功能描述。

decisions.headline: 《UN:Me》从2026年延期至2027年
decisions.reason: 符合固定窗口及来源规则，按已打开证据的事实边界收录。

decisions.headline: 《PRAGMATA》免费“Mega Man Pack”于9月17日上线

decisions.headline: 《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》Metacritic 均分为89分

decisions.headline: 《Monster Hunter Wilds》将随“Ascendance”推出免费便利性更新
decisions.reason: 符合固定窗口及来源规则，按已打开证据的事实边界收录。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW 2 Back2Back Announced

entries.headline: Mega Man: Dual Override Reveals Proto Man Gameplay and Close-Range Combat
entries.summary: Capcom showed Proto Man as the second playable character, with a high-power close-range style and a Proto Shield that supports both offense and defense.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog article directly presents the Capcom-provided character and gameplay details.

entries.headline: Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth Launches for PS5 on September 18
entries.summary: Hyper Games confirmed that its wintry Moominvalley puzzle adventure will launch for PS5 on September 18.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog developer post states both the date and the PS5 platform.

entries.headline: Sea of Thieves Season 21 Adds New Rewards and a Multi-Region Sweepstakes
entries.summary: Season 21 brings new items and rewards. The Microsoft Rewards Golden Legends Sweepstakes runs from September 17 through October 31 in seven listed markets.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire post directly lists the season content, dates, and eligible regions.

entries.headline: Silent Hill: Townfall Launches September 24 and Details PS5 Immersion Features
entries.summary: The developers confirmed a September 24 release and outlined PS5 immersion features including a first-person perspective and 3D audio.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog article supports the date, platform, and feature descriptions.

entries.headline: UN:Me Delayed from 2026 to 2027
entries.summary: Shueisha Games and historia delayed the psychological adventure to 2027 to improve the experience. It is planned for PS5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.
entries.timeNote: The later verified source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: Gematsu and Denfaminicogamer independently report the same delay and developer explanation.

entries.headline: PRAGMATA’s Free Mega Man Pack Launches September 17
entries.summary: The free crossover DLC adds four costumes for Hugh and Diana plus related content, and launches September 17.
entries.timeNote: The precisely timed source converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer independently report the same Capcom Spotlight announcement.

entries.headline: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave Holds an 89 Metacritic Score
entries.summary: Denfaminicogamer reports an 89 score across 60 Metacritic reviews and summarizes praise for the story and interconnected systems.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The score is attributed to the opened media report and is not presented as an official rating.

entries.headline: Controlled-Burn Puzzle Game NOYAKI — CONTROLLED BURN Announced
entries.summary: Pincool opened the Steam page for a puzzle game about choosing when and where to ignite grassland based on terrain and wind. The PC release is planned for Q1 2027.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report directly relays the developer’s Steam-page announcement and release plan.

entries.headline: Monster Hunter Wilds Will Receive a Free Quality-of-Life Update Alongside Ascendance
entries.summary: Capcom says the 2027 Ascendance expansion will arrive with a free update adding conveniences such as changing equipment outside tents and combined item-and-equipment loadouts.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report directly relays Capcom’s announced free-update features.

entries.headline: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW 2 Back2Back Announced for PS5 in 2027
entries.summary: Dragami Games confirmed the sequel’s title and a 2027 PS5 release, with its first playable demo scheduled for Tokyo Game Show 2026.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report directly relays Dragami Games’ formal announcement and event plans.

entries.headline: Neverness to Everness Version 1.4 Launches September 30
entries.summary: Version 1.4, For Whom the Verses Mourn, launches September 30 for PS5, PC, iOS, and Android.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly attributes the announcement to Perfect World Games and Hotta Studio.

upcoming.note: 开发商在 PlayStation Blog 确认9月18日登陆 PS5。
官方网站确认2026年9月29日推出；此补丁记录 PC 正式版。
Nintendo 美国官方商品页确认标准版于9月25日登陆 Nintendo Switch 2。
